glosses: calvary (a type of monumental public Christian cross, sometimes encased in an open shrine)
crossing (the volume formed by the intersection of chancel, nave and transepts in a cruciform church; often with a tower or cupola over it)
cruise (a sea or lake voyage, especially one taken for pleasure)

examples.text: Tom está indo em um cruzeiro.
examples.en: Tom is going on a cruise.

examples.text: Nós nos encontramos em um cruzeiro.
